column3: their exceedingly new and extending radiances; "spread all around"
column4: ವಿಸ್ತ್ರತವಾಗತಕ್ಕದ್ದೂ ಆದ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಭೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಪ್ರಸರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ
column5: The Kannada says the radiances are "to be extended" and that the rays cause them to spread; the English gives them as active "extending" and says they spread themselves.
